claim_tested: BchJ is required for normal monovinyl/divinyl protochlorophyllide balance
key_finding: Directed insertion and deletion mutants of bchJ accumulate divinyl protochlorophyllide and reduced bacteriochlorophyll; in a bchJ bchL double mutant the monovinyl:divinyl ratio is skewed toward divinyl
confidence_and_limitations: High for the phenotype. The paper infers a vinyl-reductase role from pigment pools only; no purified protein or in vitro assay. This is the origin of the bchJ = 4-vinyl reductase name

claim_tested: Which gene encodes the C8-vinyl reductase
key_finding: CT1063 (renamed bciA) insertional mutant makes only C8-vinyl pigments and recombinant BciA reduces 3,8-divinyl-protochlorophyllide using NADPH; the C. tepidum bchJ mutant still makes C8-reduced pigments but secretes divinyl-protochlorophyllide and has low BChl c
context: Chlorobaculum (Chlorobium) tepidum genetics plus recombinant enzyme assay
confidence_and_limitations: High. Directly separates the reductase (BciA) from BchJ. BchJ phenotype interpreted by the authors as substrate channelling or regulation; different organism from R. capsulatus

claim_tested: Whether an unknown third divinyl reductase exists in Rhodobacter
key_finding: A bciA/COR double mutant of Rhodobacter sphaeroides accumulates 8-vinyl-chlorophyllide, so no enzyme besides BciA and chlorophyllide a oxidoreductase acts as a divinyl reductase
confidence_and_limitations: High. R. sphaeroides encodes bchJ, so this excludes BchJ as a divinyl reductase in a Rhodobacter background. Does not test R. capsulatus directly

claim_tested: V4R domains are ligand-binding modules with a zinc site
key_finding: PoxR sensory domain (PDB 5FRW) is an intertwined homodimer with a buried phenol pocket; His102 and Trp130 contact the phenol hydroxyl; each monomer has a V4R fold with a zinc-binding site (Cys151, Glu174, Cys177, Cys185)
context: Cupriavidus necator PoxR sensory domain crystal structures
confidence_and_limitations: High for PoxR. The only experimentally solved V4R structure. Transfer to BchJ is by fold homology at 16.8% identity

claim_tested: Closest characterised structural relatives of BchJ bind a tetrapyrrole
key_finding: Tt H-NOX binds heme b with bound O2 in the pocket that structurally corresponds to the BchJ cavity
confidence_and_limitations: High for the structure. BchJ lacks the proximal histidine, so heme binding is not transferable

claim_tested: Second independent heme-bound H-NOX reference for the transplant test
key_finding: Nostoc sp. PCC 7120 H-NOX heme superposes into the same BchJ cavity as the 1U4H heme
confidence_and_limitations: High for the structure; transplant is an inference from a 2.73 A core-RMSD superposition

citation: This work (computational): AlphaFold DB AF-P26169-F1 v6
claim_tested: BchJ model is reliable enough for structural inference
key_finding: Mean pLDDT 91.6, median 97.4, 88.3% of residues above 90; only residues 1-10 and 201-213 below 70
confidence_and_limitations: High within the model's own confidence metric. pLDDT is not an experimental structure; no PAE-based domain check was run

claim_tested: BchJ fold class is ligand-binding sensor rather than oxidoreductase
key_finding: 29 of the top 30 PDB100 hits are H-NOX or sGC beta-1 heme domains plus the PoxR V4R domain; best PDB hit human sGC beta-1 8HBH E=6.2e-5 at 13.0% identity; no Rossmann, flavoprotein, radical-SAM or nitrogenase-like fold among 52 PDB hits
context: Structure search of the AlphaFold model
confidence_and_limitations: High. Remote homology at 11-17% identity; fold assignment is strong but residue-level transfer is weak

claim_tested: BchJ has no catalytic cofactor site
key_finding: No GxGxxG, no FAD fingerprint, no Walker A, no CxxCxxC, no CxxC/CxxxxC, no CXXCH in 213 residues; only the spaced C-x22-E-x2-C-x7-C
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. Motif absence is evidence against, not proof; unusual cofactor sites can escape regex detection

claim_tested: BchJ has an unannotated metal site
key_finding: C159 SG, C185 SG, C193 SG and E182 OE1 lie 2.00-2.52 A from a common centroid with no metal in the model; residue spacing +23/+26/+34 is identical to the PoxR Zn site C151/E174/C177/C185
confidence_and_limitations: High geometric signal. The metal identity (Zn assumed from PoxR) is not determined; no experimental metal analysis of BchJ exists

citation: This work (computational): co-conservation across 985 Foldseek AFDB50 homologs
claim_tested: The Cys3 site is functional rather than incidental
key_finding: Observed P(all three Cys) 0.267 vs 0.039 expected under independence; pairwise Fisher OR 38-206, p < 1e-114; Cys3 completeness 71.7% in V4R/BchJ-named vs 5.3% in H-NOX/guanylate cyclase proteins (chi-square 388.8, p = 3.7e-85)
context: Structure-derived alignment of the V4R/H-NOX superfamily
confidence_and_limitations: High. Alignment comes from Foldseek pairwise alignments, not a curated MSA; protein naming used to define branches is itself database annotation

claim_tested: The predicted metal site is not a single-model artifact
key_finding: Eight independent AlphaFold models from 10.4-76.8% identity converge the same four atoms to within 2.36-3.21 A of a centroid at local pLDDT 92.5-98.6; four Cys-free homologs show no site
context: AlphaFold models of V4R homologs from Rhodobacter aestuarii to Candidatus Methanoperedens
confidence_and_limitations: High. All models come from the same predictor, so a systematic AlphaFold bias toward closing Cys clusters cannot be excluded

claim_tested: BchJ has a porphyrin-sized binding pocket
key_finding: The largest buried pocket in the apo monomer model is 85-304 A^3 depending on burial cutoff, against roughly 600 A^3 for heme b and roughly 700 A^3 for a bacteriochlorophyllide macrocycle; the pocket is 71% apolar and coincides with the transplanted heme and phenol sites
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. Apo models collapse pockets, and the characterised V4R (PoxR) buries its ligand across a homodimer, so monomer volume underestimates the functional cavity

citation: This work (computational): KEGG genomic context and KO co-occurrence
key_finding: bchJ (RCAP_rcc00670) sits between bchE and bchG in the R. capsulatus photosynthesis gene cluster; across 682 (B)Chl-producing KEGG genomes bchJ is in 139, all 139 also carry bchX (COR), and bchJ is depleted for bciA/bciB (Fisher OR 0.31, p = 9.9e-9)
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. KEGG KO assignment K04036 still carries the refuted reductase name and an incomplete EC; gene-cluster position cannot distinguish an enzyme from a carrier because the same cluster holds PucC, PpsR and TspO

key_finding: UniProt names P26169 'Bacteriochlorophyll synthase 23 kDa chain' with no MF term; GO annotations are GO:0030494 bacteriochlorophyll biosynthetic process (IMP:CACAO), GO:0036070 (IEA:UniPathway) and GO:0015979 photosynthesis (IEA:InterPro)
confidence_and_limitations: Database-level only. The legacy name reflects the bchJ-bchG operon, not a demonstrated activity; GO:0015979 by InterPro transfer is weakly justified
